plugins/audit/scripts/git/_worktrees.py: (a) `tree_unsettled(tree, run=None, now=None)` -> {unsettled True|False|None, kept, why, cleared}: the one reading of whether a move's copy (admin_dir/audit-advance) or its tombstone stands beside a task tree, read through the same `_left_beside` every move's `kept` uses; None (could-not-ask, never settled) when git will not name the admin dir; `why` is `kept_where()`, which names <copy>/N.bin, <copy>/index.json and <copy>/git-index. (b) `_clear_strays`: the `.audit-*` temp files `_write_aside` leaves in the admin dir after a hard kill are removed by tree_unsettled once older than STRAY_AGE_SECONDS (a younger one may be a write in flight and is left); `_write_aside` now takes its prefix from STRAY_PREFIX (same value). (c) `restore_copy(tree, task_id, is_record=None, run=None)` -> {restored True|False|None, kept, paths, error}: puts the tree back at the copy's `from` from N.bin + git-index through `_undo` and its `_answers_as` check, drops the copy; refuses with nothing written when the marker does not name the task at the copy's base (a recorded move: the next move drops it), the copy has no index.json or will not read, or `_newer_work` names a path the copy does not hold; None when no copy stands (a tombstone alone is cleared). (d) `_reads_as` hashes with `hash-object --no-filters`; its docstring states the cost (under core.autocrlf, a moved file a killed checkout already wrote reads as differing, so a resumed move holds instead of finishing). Module docstring: writes git in two places now (advance_tree, restore_copy).
plugins/audit/scripts/governance/drive-phase.py: `unsettled_stop(ctx, task, tree)` and `unsettled_said(...)` (stop names the copy's files and `restore_command()` = `python3 <drive-phase.py> restore <id> <manifest> --project-dir <project>`); read by `dispatch` (when a tree is given), `integrate_member` (before integrating), `remove_task_tree` (first check, so retirement and both kept-tree removers refuse while a copy or tombstone stands) and `advance_member` (re-reads the predicate after the move; could-not-ask there stays the move's own tree-not-moved decision). A tree directory that is gone is no stop in unsettled_stop (the verb refuses it by name; retire_member runs no removal for it). New subcommand `restore <taskId> [manifest] [--project-dir DIR]` (`run_restore`/`restore_tree`): tree from the drive state's wave.trees, records from member_records, under the phase lock (released unless a drive held it before); exit 0 restored, 1 refused (copy stays), 2 no tree / no copy. Usage and exit-code docstring updated.
